content.name: Natalia Wiśniewska
content.title: Medizinische Fachangestellte (MFA)
content.summary: Newly qualified Medizinische Fachangestellte who trained for three years in a busy general practice in Köln-Ehrenfeld and now works in an internal medicine practice. Confident with blood draws, ECGs, practice software and patients in German, Polish and English.

experience.title: Auszubildende Medizinische Fachangestellte (Trainee MFA)
bullets: Learned reception, scheduling and billing for a two-doctor GP practice with about 1,400 patients per quarter.
Took 15–20 blood samples a day and performed ECGs, spirometry and wound care under the doctors' supervision.
Managed the vaccination recall list for flu and pneumococcal jabs and helped run Saturday vaccine clinics for 300+ patients.
Passed the final exam before the Ärztekammer Nordrhein with grade 'gut' (2).

experience.title: Medizinische Fachangestellte
bullets: Prepare patients for ultrasound, long-term ECG and 24-hour blood pressure monitoring in a practice seeing 90 patients a day.
Manage lab orders and results in the practice software and contact patients when the doctor asks for follow-up.
Handle e-prescriptions and electronic sick notes, reducing paper requests at the front desk.

education.details: Dual training: practice placement plus vocational school.
